text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ogurii!!
Don't lose to Super Creek!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Inariii!! You can do it!
You're the top dog of the Eternal Big Three!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before long, people began calling the trio of Oguri Cap,
Super Creek, and Inari One
the defining Big Three of the era—the Eternal Big Three.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Those three would battle for the crown at the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
With the entire nation's attention focused on the race...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the waiting room for the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
Sakura Chiyono O took a quiet, deep breath, and opened her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I've been thinking ever since summer camp.
About how I should fight as someone who is gradually losing pieces of herself.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen-san told me:
'Even if a piece of me is missing,
I'll keep running as the me I am right now.'

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I knew it, but I didn't want to admit it. That's why it was pure stubbornness. By sticking to my pride, I took back who I truly am.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I might be different from before, but I want to be a version of myself that won't lose to the old me, either.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the words given to me by Maruzen-san
and my precious rival, my resolve is set.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...Accept the fragility. Rather than trying
to restore what's broken, shatter it completely."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If things can never go back to how they were,
I thought I might as well use up everything I have right now and destroy it all.
choice_data_list: So you're saying you're going to be reckless!?
Wait, does that mean you're being reckless!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: N-No. It's not like I'm trying to get injured on purpose!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ever since we talked about my peak, I've been terrified of my present self crumbling away.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"But if I break everything down without leaving a single piece behind...
Perhaps beyond that, a new me awaits.
A me far stronger than I am now."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Doesn't that make you feel like there's a bright future ahead?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, please watch over me.
...Watch the moment I am reborn."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yes...!
Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Looking at Sakura Chiyono O, who seemed to have fully recovered, I thought to myself: she was truly blessed with great rivals.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan, Yaeno Muteki,
and the one she had always yearned for—Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there, Mr. Trainer.
This is a sensation only those who run can understand.
Just like how only support staff truly know what it takes to support.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there, Ms. Trainer.
This is a sensation only those who run can understand.
Just like how only support staff truly know what it takes to support.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Compared to that, I wonder...
what have I ever been able to give her?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not being a competitor who races on equal footing with her,
I...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Like "Chiyo's the pot, and Trainer's the ladle"!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: The pot and the ladle each have different roles, but to make a delicious chanko stew, you need them both together!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, Trainer.
I should be heading off now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...?
What might it be, Trainer?
choice_data_list: I'll support you with everything I've got.
I'll cheer you on with all I've got!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...! Fufu... yes.
Please keep your eyes on my run.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
And—please push me forward.
Just like you always have.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!
A fierce lineup of top contenders has gathered!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Among them, the "Eternal Big Three"—
Oguri Cap, Super Creek, and Inari One—
are all present and accounted for!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(So these are the prodigies,
the Umamusume currently at the top of their game.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(Still, no matter who my opponent is, I will not lose.
And that includes... to myself.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Meeting each other on a GⅠ stage...
It's been since the Derby, hasn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Ardan-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Chiyono O-san. You are trying to achieve
a miracle even greater than mine back then, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I won't simply hand over
victory in this Tenno Sho to you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —Because I am your rival, after all.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Likewise, allow me to
challenge you with everything I have."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
And I look forward to seeing
what we will gain
after this match is over.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you both.
For being my rivals.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Still, with an unyielding spirit determined never to surrender victory!
Sakura Chiyono O, here I come!!"
